[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Maximum profit in job scheduling** [LC 1235 · Maximum Profit in Job Scheduling](https://leetcode.com/problems/maximum-profit-in-job-scheduling/){difficulty="Hard"}

Every job is taken or skipped, and taking it forbids every job that overlaps it. Sort by end time and look at the last job. If the best plan skips it, the rest is a best plan for the jobs before it. If the best plan takes it, the rest is a best plan for the jobs that end at or before it starts, and those are a prefix. Earliest-end on the first sample takes $[1,3)$ and then $[3,5)$ for 90, and misses $50+70$. Largest-profit on the second sample takes the 100 and then only $[1,3)$, for 120, and misses $20+70+60$.

[Solved in full in @sec-od-p2-sched.]{.card-link}

:::
